mechanism.name: TM-S2-C03 coarse-family move ordering
mechanism.workerContract: worker already forwards options; no worker-source change is authorized for v1

actorReusablePits.definition: count across the actor's 16 board pits with seed count >= 2

trigger.multipleMatchingMoves: all matching moves receive equal candidate priority; existing downstream comparator resolves order; no pit-index preference may be added

orderingPlacement.priorityPosition: after immediate-win / optional TT-first / captured-seed ordering and before non-TT preferred/killer/history/static ordering
orderingPlacement.reason: conservative tie-class ordering; the research result does not justify forcing the C03 family over a tactically stronger move class

candidateSpecificPopulation.source: the frozen PBAI-C decision-quality root populations; no Research Generation 1 formal observation is reused as an engineering outcome
targetEligibility: actor reusablePits in 0..2 using the frozen count definition
at least one legal coarse-no-index C03 matching move
at least one legal nonmatching alternative
candidateSpecificPopulation.selection: within each frozen source block, take eligible roots in the already frozen outcome/value-blind deterministic hash order
candidateSpecificPopulation.insufficientSupportAction: NON-ESTIMABLE/HOLD; no replacement from another seed block after outcome inspection

negativeControls.gate: with feature on, trigger count must be zero and fixed-depth selected move/root score/search counters must be exactly feature-off equivalent on every negative-control root

candidateSpecificBenefitGate.primaryEndpoint: fixed-depth D4 search-node efficiency on eligible target roots with candidate feature on versus feature off
candidateSpecificBenefitGate.measurement: for each root, total nodes = nodes reported by hard enhanced search at maxDepth=4, timeLimitMs=Infinity, evaluationProfile=bao; compare paired feature-on/off runs

developmentStoppingRule.ifDevelopmentBenefitGateFails: REJECT or HOLD PBAI-C002-v1; a materially different mechanism requires a new candidate version/contract before outcomes
developmentStoppingRule.ifAnyGlobalHardGateFails: REJECT/HOLD; strength or efficiency may not offset failure

validationAndHoldoutFirewall.releaseHoldoutAuthorizationCondition: candidate source/config hash frozen after fresh validation PASS plus explicit PBAI-F authorization

rollback.preAdoption: feature flag off reproduces AI-GEN2 baseline behavior
rollback.publicReleaseRollback: restore prior public/ai.js and service-worker cache identity according to PBAI-C PWA release-safety contract
